newsitem.title: UK: GA, B.A.T up as insurers advance.
newsitem.headline: GA, B.A.T up as insurers advance.

text.p: Shares in General Accident Plc (GA) romped higher for a second day on Friday as recent bid speculation in the insurance sector left market-makers short of stock, dealers said.
B.A.T Industries Plc was also caught up in the wave of interest in the sector and up 16-1/2p at 508 by 0916 GMT. GA rose 15p at 836 after yesterday gaining 24p.
Commercial Union Plc rose 9-1/2p to 727-1/2 on top of yesterday's 23p gain.
In the life assurance sector, another recent focus of bid speculation, Legal & General Plc was up 5-1/2p at 405, and Prudential Corp Plc was up 5p at 570.

"The market is short and there are some takeover candidates out there," said the head of equity trading at one brokerage. "There is not a lot of business around, it is just market-makers leapfrogging one another."
Volume in GA, for instance, was an unexceptional 345,159 shares.
The latest bout of bid activity in the sector was sparked earlier this week with Prudential's 1.9 billion stg bid for mutually-owned Scottish Amicable.
Recent mergers in the sector included the link-up that created Royal & Sun Alliance Plc.
